Systemic across the commonMain repository layer: every repository that wraps a suspend Ktor call in try/catch uses a bare `catch (e: Exception)` and folds the throwable into `Result.failure(e)` WITHOUT first rethrowing kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException.
